$comment: Normative (FLR-ADR-006, FLR-ADR-007): FS_structural 0.1.0, registry/FS_structural/spec.md. The root applies to the extension's top-level data, extensions.FS_structural, which 0.1 gives no members. FS_structural's data lives on core elements: the data on an element of collection C (its own extensions.FS_structural) is checked as the object { C: data } against #/$defs/coreElements, which names the five collections it is defined for and no other (spec.md 1.3). Attributes recorded for handoff, never a structural design or a check of one (spec.md 1.4).
title: FS_structural 0.1.0
description: Bearing and shear flags, framing, spans and headers recorded on walls, openings, slabs, rooms' floors and roofs.

coreElements.title: Data on core elements
coreElements.description: 1.3: an element's collection mapped to its FS_structural data. Only walls, openings, slabs, rooms and roofs carry FS_structural data.

material.description: 2.2: what the members, or the solid assembly, are made of.

member.title: Member
member.description: 2.1: one member's section: its trade designation as text, and its actual width and depth.

designation.description: 2.1: what the trade calls it - "2x6", "1-3/4 x 11-7/8 LVL", "W8x10" - a label, 1-40 characters; never read for a dimension.

width.description: 2.1: the actual dimension across its narrow face, a length; at most 1 m.

depth.description: 2.1: the actual dimension in the direction it carries load - across the wall for a stud, vertical for a joist, a rafter or a header - a length; at most 1 m.

system.description: 2.2: how it is built: studs, solid, panels.

spacing.description: 2.2: the distance from one member's centre to the next (on centre), a length; at most 5 m.

floorFraming.title: Floor framing
floorFraming.description: 2.2: how a floor or a deck is built.

system.description: 2.2: how it is built: joists, trusses, solid, panels.

spacing.description: 2.2: the distance from one member's centre to the next (on centre), a length; at most 5 m.

system.description: 2.2: how it is built: rafters, trusses, solid, panels.

spacing.description: 2.2: the distance from one member's centre to the next (on centre), a length; at most 5 m.

span.title: Span
span.description: 3.1: the direction a floor's members span, and its clear span when the writer records one.

direction.description: 3.1: a vector in the level's plan coordinates, [x, y], along which the members span; not [0, 0] (FS-STRC-3.1.1, an invariant).

length.description: 3.1: the clear span the writer records, a length. Absent: the derived extent (3.2) stands for it.

header.title: Header
header.description: 2.4: the member over an opening that carries what is above it.

plies.description: 2.4: how many members, side by side, make it.

bearing.description: 2.3: true when the wall carries vertical load from above - a floor, a roof, a wall - besides its own weight; false when it does not. Absent: not stated.

shear.description: 2.3: true when the wall is part of the lateral system that resists wind and earthquakes; false when it is not. Absent: not stated.

needsEngineer.description: 2.6: true when the writer flags the element for a licensed professional - an engineer or an architect - to design or confirm. Absent: not stated.

note.description: 2.6: a note for whoever designs or checks the structure, 1-2000 characters.
